title: Video LoRA Trainer (Wan 2.1 & Wan 2.2)
description: Train Wan 2.1 / Wan 2.2 LoRAs from a zip of videos or images with kohya-ss/musubi-tuner on Runpod Serverless. Send a dataset URL and a trigger word; get a .safetensors LoRA on your Hugging Face repo, S3 bucket or network volume. Default is the 1.3B T2V model (24 GB). 14B and Wan 2.2 work best on 48 GB.

config.gpuIds: ADA_24,AMPERE_24,ADA_48_PRO,AMPERE_48,-NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition MIG 1g.24gb,-NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition MIG 2g.48gb

presets.name: Wan 2.2 T2V both experts (48 GB recommended)

input.name: Base model
input.description: wan-t2v-1.3b is the default (no token, fits 24 GB). 14B and Wan 2.2 A14B are large (48 GB recommended). Hunyuan and FramePack are not in v1. Override per job with input.base_model.

options.label: Wan 2.2 I2V A14B (needs video, 48 GB recommended)

input.name: Preset
input.description: Named defaults for steps, rank, learning rate and resolution. Explicit settings win.

input.name: Default trigger word
input.description: Unique token that activates the LoRA, e.g. 'zxowl'. Usually set per job (input.trigger_word).

input.name: Default dataset URL
input.description: https URL of a .zip/.tar.gz with videos and/or images and same-name .txt captions. Usually sent per job (input.dataset_url).

input.name: Training steps
input.description: Optimizer steps. ~2000 for a real LoRA; 20 for a smoke test.

input.name: LoRA rank
input.description: Network dim. 16 is a good default; 32 for a stronger style LoRA.

input.name: Learning rate
input.description: 2e-4 is the musubi-tuner default for Wan LoRAs with AdamW8bit.

input.name: Resolution
input.description: WxH or a single number (square). Must be a multiple of 16. Default 832x480; use 512 for a quick test. On 24 GB, drop 14B jobs to 640x480 or 480x480.

input.name: Target frames
input.description: Video lengths to extract, each N×4+1 (e.g. 17 or 17,25). Ignored for image-only datasets. Default 17.

input.name: Wan 2.2 mode
input.description: Wan 2.2 only: train both high+low experts (default), or only the low- or high-noise DiT.

input.name: Captions
input.description: auto = use .txt captions when present, else the trigger word; trigger = ignore captions; existing = prefer .txt files.

input.name: Sample videos
input.description: Short clips rendered after training (0-4). Default 0 — video sampling is expensive.

input.name: Hugging Face output repo
input.description: Optional 'user/repo' to upload the LoRA + model card. Needs HF_TOKEN with write access.

input.name: Private HF repo
input.description: Create the output repo as private.

input.name: HF_TOKEN
input.description: Hugging Face token with write access for HF_OUTPUT_REPO. Default Wan weights are public and do not need a token. Use a Runpod secret: {{ RUNPOD_SECRET_hf_token }}.

input.name: Also write ComfyUI LoRA
input.description: Run convert_lora.py --target other and deliver a second file.

input.name: Blocks to swap
input.description: auto (default, based on VRAM), 0 to disable, or an integer. Max 29 for 1.3B and 39 for 14B. Mutually exclusive with inactive-DiT CPU offload.

input.name: Checkpoint every N steps
input.description: Intermediate LoRA files (useful with a network volume). 0 = final only.

input.name: Training watchdog (s)
input.description: Kill musubi-tuner after this many seconds (0 = off). Keep below the endpoint execution timeout. Cold start can download ~13.5 GiB for the default 1.3B stack.
